name: example
description: A working tour of what a plugin can add: a dashboard screen and menu link, records of its own, a query across posts, dashboard notices and taskbar counts, a quick action, a block, a Markdown page, a note on every entry's Markdown, settings and a command. For development only: it is never published or rendered into applications.
